title: An explosion from rest
caption: Momentum before is zero, so the two pieces carry equal and opposite momenta of 28.3 kg m s⁻¹. Sharing the 600 J between them gives the 1.0 kg piece 28.3 m s⁻¹ and the 2.0 kg piece 14.1 m s⁻¹.
alt: Two momentum arrows of 28.3 kilogram metres per second pointing in opposite directions from the explosion point, adding to zero.
description: Energy: ½(1)v₁² + ½(2)v₂² = 600 J, so 3v₂² = 600 and v₂ = 14.14 m s⁻¹, v₁ = 28.28 m s⁻¹.
Each piece has momentum 28.28 kg m s⁻¹, in opposite directions; the total stays zero.
